description: Cabinet simulator: it convolves a mono signal with up to two impulse responses loaded from WAV files, fades between them, and puts a high-pass and a low-pass filter on the result

params.text: With both impulse responses loaded, fades from the first fully anticlockwise to the second fully clockwise; with only one loaded, fades from the unprocessed signal to the convolved one
Sets the corner of the 2-pole low-pass filter on the output, 1000Hz fully anticlockwise to 20000Hz fully clockwise, on a logarithmic scale
Sets the corner of the 2-pole high-pass filter on the output, 20Hz fully anticlockwise to 2000Hz fully clockwise, on a logarithmic scale
Sets the output gain, from silence to double

inputs.text: The signal to be convolved, mono, with 5V taken as full scale
Takes over the BLEND control while patched, -5V for one end of the fade and 5V for the other; the knob does nothing while a cable is in here
Takes over the LP corner while patched, -5V for 1000Hz and 5V for 20000Hz; the knob does nothing while a cable is in here
Takes over the HP corner while patched, -5V for 20Hz and 5V for 2000Hz; the knob does nothing while a cable is in here
Takes over the output gain while patched, -5V for silence and 5V for double; the knob does nothing while a cable is in here

notes: with no impulse response loaded the module passes its input through the two filters and the output gain, and nothing else; load one from the right-click menu
an impulse response is cut to one second and resampled to the engine's rate as it loads, and is reloaded from its file whenever the engine's sample rate changes
the panel prints IR1 and IR2 beside the two lamps, while the menu calls the same two slots IR A and IR B; a lit lamp means that slot holds an impulse response
the menu prints a line under the two slots saying what the blend control is doing: a crossfade between the two responses when both are loaded, or a dry-to-wet fade when only one is
menu: Load IR A... — opens a file dialogue for a WAV impulse response to put in the first slot
Unload IR A — empties the first slot, greyed out when nothing is in it
Normalize IR A — scales the first impulse response to full scale as it is loaded, which evens out the level between different files
Load IR B... — opens a file dialogue for a WAV impulse response to put in the second slot
Unload IR B — empties the second slot, greyed out when nothing is in it
Normalize IR B — scales the second impulse response to full scale as it is loaded, which evens out the level between different files

inputs.1:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the BLEND knob.
inputs.2:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the LP knob.
inputs.3:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the HP knob.
inputs.4:

unpatched it reads the OUTPUT knob.
